candidates.name: Plexiform Schwannoma
support_spans: On T1-weighted images, the lesions were homogeneously isointense to skeletal muscle.
On T2-weighted fat-suppressed images, they were homogeneously hyperintense without cystic degeneration; each was surrounded by a hyperintense rim.
A small extension of high signal from the lateral aspect of one lesion resembled a “mouse-tail.”
candidates.why: The imaging findings and clinical presentation are consistent with plexiform schwannoma, particularly the homogeneous isointensity on T1-weighted images and hyperintensity on T2-weighted images, as well as the presence of a 'mouse-tail' sign.
